technical-summary: Added safe timed log rotation fallback for Windows locked-file rollover and covered it with regression tests.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed startup logging errors when another AUDiaGentic process still has diagnostic log open on Windows.

technical-summary: Extracted shared LSP orchestration into lsp_api, made MCP modules thin delegates, moved diagnostics behind SessionManager API, and added regression tests for root/language resolution.
user-summary-candidate: Refactored coding LSP so MCP tools are thin wrappers over internal LSP services.

technical-summary: Renamed generic optional-component root modules to component-prefixed names, extracted provider and source-control internal APIs, made MCP wrappers delegate to *_api modules, and added guardrail tests for naming and same-component MCP imports.
user-summary-candidate: Refactored optional components so module names are explicit and MCP servers stay thin wrappers over internal APIs.

technical-summary: Removed stale module-path and entrypoint references left by component renames, including legacy ledger bootstrap metadata and outdated knowledge README commands.
user-summary-candidate: Cleaned leftover old module references after component naming refactor.

technical-summary: Canonicalized MCP tool naming by removing project _tool suffixes, consolidating release status onto get_release_status, renaming provider_status to get_provider_status, and pruning public provider tools that directly edit provider MCP config or bypass managed reconciliation.
user-summary-candidate: Cleaned MCP tool names and removed confusing public provider config-edit tools.

technical-summary: Validated that embedded ownership metadata was not safely provable across all provider config formats, then implemented a small managed MCP registry keyed by stable managed_id so AUDiaGentic can rename or remove only its own provider MCP entries while preserving external entries.
user-summary-candidate: AUDiaGentic now tracks which provider MCP entries it owns, so renames and cleanup do not disturb external entries.

technical-summary: Made ledger summary reads reuse existing CURRENT_RELEASE.md instead of regenerating on every read, added explicit refresh_current_summary and optional record_change(sync=False), and made manifest writes atomic with tolerant status reads.
user-summary-candidate: Made ledger reads cheaper and manifest handling safer.

technical-summary: Added record_changes(...) to batch multiple fragment writes and optionally sync once at the end, with tests proving deferred sync leaves the current ledger untouched until final merge.
user-summary-candidate: Added batched ledger recording to avoid repeated sync work.

technical-summary: Made current release ledger rebuild from fragments only, so CURRENT_RELEASE_LEDGER.ndjson is treated as generated output and stale/manual entries are discarded on sync.
user-summary-candidate: Made fragments the sole source of truth for current release ledger sync.

technical-summary: Deleted 12 individual toolchain delegate files (npm.py, uv.py, brew.py, etc.) and replaced with a single __init__.py that generates namespace objects dynamically from toolchains.yaml via _make_tc(). Moved toolchains/ out of foundation/invoke/ to foundation/toolchains/ and deleted the invoke/ directory (including follow_up_executor.py with no callers). Deleted log_context.py shim (zero callers). Winget acceptance flags moved from per-dep YAML into toolchains.yaml as toolchain-level install template behavior.
user-summary-candidate: Toolchain declarations consolidated from 12 Python files into a single YAML-driven loader. Foundation layout cleaned up.

technical-summary: Removed hardcoded SYSTEM_DEPENDENCIES dict and DependencySpec/_PlatformStep/install_dependencies orchestration lane from dependencies.py. Dependency declarations moved to component YAML files (source-control.yaml, coding-lsp.yaml) using probe:/via:/toolchain:/package: vocabulary. lsp_dependencies.py deleted. New API: load_component_workflow(component_id, action) returns SequenceStep; load_component_probes(component_id) returns probe callables; detect_missing() takes probe dict. Component callers (source_control_api.py, lsp_api.py, coding_lsp_bootstrap.py) updated to use new loader API.
user-summary-candidate: Dependency declarations moved out of hardcoded Python into component YAML files. Install/uninstall logic now expressed as workflow steps, eliminating a separate dependency management lane.

technical-summary: Added SelectStep to steps.py: generic N-variant runtime dispatch (select(ctx)->str|None; None=skipped, missing key+no fallback=failed). Replaced _PlatformStep with SelectStep(select=detect_pkg_manager). Added raw_step() factory to toolchains/loader.py so dependencies.py never imports ShellStep directly — layer boundary enforced. Extracted _guarded(dep_id, probe_fn, inner, skip_when_true) helper to remove duplicated probe-guard pattern. Moved SequenceStep import in source_control_api.py from deferred (inside function bodies) to module-level. Tests rewritten to cover SelectStep semantics and probe-guard pattern.
user-summary-candidate: Added SelectStep workflow primitive for N-variant runtime dispatch. Layer boundaries enforced: toolchains/ never imported from dependency layer. Probe-guard pattern extracted to shared helper.

technical-summary: Added cli_recipe() factory to descriptors/base.py that calls build_step() via deferred import. Eliminated direct foundation.toolchains imports from all 12 standard-toolchain provider descriptor files (npm x8, uv x2, vscode x1, brew x1). goose (raw ShellStep script) and pi (CallableStep harness) unchanged. CliInstallRecipe structure and provisioning layer unchanged.
user-summary-candidate: Provider descriptors no longer import foundation toolchains directly. Install specs are now declared via cli_recipe() which builds steps through the toolchain loader.

technical-summary: Fixed inv.status AttributeError in provider_cli_plan (dict not object). Added _ProviderCliConfig adapter to ProviderCliWorkflowContext so StateMachine ctx.config protocol is satisfied. Updated stale test references: _step_for_action->_build_step, _load_provider_cli_config replaced with state-table and supports_provider_cli_workflow checks, _find_pid_listening_on_port->find_pid_on_port, _kill_pid->kill_pid, pi tests patching _build_step instead of _pi_install, uv-tool->uv package-manager string, uv arg ordering updated.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed provider CLI plan crash and state machine protocol mismatch. All pre-existing provider and provisioning test failures resolved.

technical-summary: Repaired four current-source regressions surfacing through the core MCP component tools. (1) Restored public default_config_path() on the harness facade (runtime/harness/__init__.py); session_manage_mcp imported it but the component-wrapper refactor left only private _harness_cfg_path(), breaking ag_session_mgmt status/config with ImportError. _harness_cfg_path now delegates to it. (2) project_manage_mcp install/uninstall/enable/disable tools called themselves recursively (TypeError: takes 1 positional argument but 2 were given) instead of delegating; now import runtime.lifecycle.components functions under _lifecycle_* aliases and call those. (3) foundation/components/hooks.py invoke_hook except-branch referenced undefined _log instead of module logger, masking any status-hook failure with 'name _log is not defined'. (4) coding_lsp_bootstrap.status_payload referenced undefined 'deps' for dependency labels; added public load_component_dep_labels() in foundation/dependencies.py (reads display-name from component YAML) and a module-level _LSP_DEP_LABELS map. The coding-lsp status hook was the actual raiser; the hooks.py bug only made it surface as the misleading _log error in list_components/project_status. (5) Restored version_info() on the harness facade and added its pi-harness impl (harness/pi/install/__init__.py) resolving agent + mcp_adapter versions from env override else pi.yaml; session status previously failed with 'cannot import name version_info'. Verified end-to-end by driving the built FastMCP servers in-process: list_components (9 components), project_status (installed), session config (no error), session status (agent 0.77.0, mcp_adapter latest).
user-summary-candidate: Fixed broken project and session MCP tools (component listing, install/enable/disable, status/config) left over from the component-wrapper refactor.

technical-summary: Fixed missing runtime data files in the built wheel, exposed by clean-install testing in an isolated Docker container (the editable src layout masked it on the host). setuptools package-data omitted several globs, so a packaged install raised FileNotFoundError for foundation/toolchains/toolchains.yaml when provider descriptors call has_action() at import, breaking the providers MCP server. Added package-data globs: config/provisioning/foundation/*.yaml, foundation/toolchains/*.yaml, foundation/contracts/schemas/**/*.json (jsonschema validation incl. change-event schema used by the ledger), components/optional/knowledge/runtime_data/*.yml, providers adapters/**/*.md and surfaces/templates/*.md instruction/prompt-tag templates, runtime/build/*.yaml, runtime/rig/external/*.yaml, runtime/harness/opencode/templates/**/*.md. Added a slim isolated smoke test (tests/docker/Dockerfile.server-smoke + _server_smoke.py) that builds the wheel and exercises all 11 MCP servers. Result after fix: 11/11 servers pass in a clean --network none container.
user-summary-candidate: Fixed missing data files in the packaged wheel that broke the providers MCP server on a clean install, and added a Docker smoke test covering all MCP servers.

technical-summary: Removed the stale committed repo-root agent/ directory drift. agent/ is entirely generated by pi materialize_agent_config (mcp.json, models.json, settings.json, extensions/, APPEND_SYSTEM.md) and the live config lives at ~/.audiagentic/harness/agent/; the committed copy had drifted (mcp.json listed renamed modules ledger_write_mcp, coding_lsp.mcp_server, providers.manage_mcp and old server names). Untracked the directory via git rm --cached (kept on disk) and added root-anchored /agent/ to .gitignore. No generator changes needed: mcp_collector.collect_mcp_servers already derives every server name/module purely from component YAML mcp_servers declarations with no hardcoded entries or fallbacks; verified it emits the correct canonical modules (ag-ledger->ledger_mcp, ag-lsp->lsp_mcp, ag-providers-mgmt->providers_manage_mcp, etc.). Source templates under src/audiagentic/runtime/harness/pi/templates/home/agent/ remain tracked.
user-summary-candidate: Stopped tracking the generated agent/ runtime directory (it had drifted from canonical config); the materialized agent config is now regenerated on demand from component declarations only.

technical-summary: Ledger efficiency: default sync=False to break O(N^2) I/O, incremental append-only sync with fragment-id tracking, no-op skip when fragments unchanged.
user-summary-candidate: Made ledger sync O(N) instead of O(N^2) — fragments now append incrementally with no-op detection.

technical-summary: Reviewed package structure and entry modules across components, foundation, runtime, and packaged config. Added brief README coverage for every Python code directory under src/audiagentic that previously lacked an intent doc, and refreshed top-level foundation/runtime summaries so agents can quickly identify ownership boundaries, key capabilities, and where to drill deeper.
user-summary-candidate: Added brief agent-facing READMEs across AUDiaGentic code areas so each component and functional package explains its purpose and boundaries.

technical-summary: Reworked LSP provisioning into native + generic layers with config-driven language registry. Added per-language YAML config files (python/typescript/rust/cpp) under config/components/optional/coding-lsp/ and language_registry.py owning server command, extensions, detection markers, languageId, and dependency recipe; coding_lsp_config.py now reads the registry (removed _DEFAULT_SERVERS/_DETECTION_MARKERS/_PROBE_SPECS) and moved the dependencies block out of coding-lsp.yaml. Added cfg-injectable build_dependency_* variants in dependencies.py so coding-lsp sources deps from the registry. Scoped lsp_install_dependencies to configured languages (rejects non-enabled deps; empty installs configured-missing only); added missing_configured_dependencies. Added native LSP handlers: LanguageServersConfigSpec.remover field, codex remover, new opencode (.opencode/opencode.json lsp section, preserves mcp) and qwen (.lsp.json string-command+args) handlers wired into descriptors. Fixed prune to remove via remover (was a no-op writing {}). Added McpServerDeclaration.skip_if_native_lsp flag (default false), parsed in loader, set on ag-lsp, filtered in _propagate_mcp_to_providers so codex/opencode are not also given generic ag-lsp (qwen shares .mcp.json so retains it). Added unit tests (registry, scoped install, native round-trip, real prune, suppression) and a Docker e2e (install lsp+languages, validate native/generic config per provider, server binaries run, deps resolved, LSP works per language) plus Dockerfile.
user-summary-candidate: LSP now installs only the language servers for languages you enable, writes native LSP config for Codex/OpenCode/Qwen (and skips the redundant generic LSP server for them), and adds per-language config files so adding a language is a single drop-in file.
